title: 第5章  当众休妻：赵雪莲不配！
content_zh:
楚枫左手牵着一条玄铁锁链，锁链的另一端拴在赵雪莲的脖颈上。
每走一步，锁链便发出“哗啦”的刺耳声响。
赵雪莲双手在地上艰难爬行，华贵的衣裙早已被磨得破烂不堪。
散乱的发丝遮住了她大半张脸，只露出一双怨毒的眼睛，死死盯着地面。
楚枫，你给我等着，等我爹回来，我要骑在你身上，爬遍整个青山城。
让所有人都知道，你是我的一条狗！
这一幕，很快便惊动了赵家众人。
四周的赵家人围得水泄不通，脸上都写满了滔天的愤怒，皆是对着楚枫破口大骂。
“他妈的畜生啊，畜生啊！”
“竟敢如此对待大小姐，简直猪狗不如！”
“大小姐留他一条狗命，他如今竟然恩将仇报！”
这些咒骂声此起彼伏，像是潮水般涌向楚枫。
楚枫的目光扫过那些叫嚣得最厉害的人，嘴角勾起一抹讥讽的弧度。
这些人对着他指指点点，却没有一个人敢真正上前。
“聒噪。”
话音未落，楚枫屈指轻弹，数道凝练如匹练的灵力骤然射出，速度快得让人根本反应不过来。
噗！噗！噗！
一连串沉闷的声音响起，刚才那些骂得最凶的人，脑袋瞬间被灵力匹练洞穿，鲜血混合着脑浆喷涌而出。
他们的尸体直挺挺地倒在地上，眼睛瞪得滚圆，还残留着临死前的惊愕。
刚才还喧闹无比的庭院，瞬间陷入了死一般的寂静。

所有人都被这突如其来的血腥场面吓傻了，刚才还义愤填膺的众人，此刻纷纷后退，生怕下一个遭殃的就是自己。
赵雪莲也被这一幕吓得浑身一颤，爬行的动作顿了顿。
她猛地抬起头，散乱的发丝下，一双眼睛死死盯着楚枫。
“你到底要带我去哪？”
楚枫居高临下地看着她，阳光洒在他脸上，却照不进他眼底的一丝寒意。
“你父亲回来了，做女儿的，当然要出门去好好迎接他。”
“我爹回来了？”赵雪莲瞳孔骤缩，随即心中一喜，“我爹一定会为我报仇的，他会让你受尽世间最痛苦的折磨而死！”
楚枫嗤笑一声，狠狠踢了她一脚。
“老子等着他来！”
没过多久，远处传来震天的怒吼，划破了庭院的寂静。
“楚枫，你这个小杂种，给老子滚出来受死！”
众人循声望去，只见一位中年男子气势汹汹地冲向前院，来人正是赵家家主赵泰。
他身后跟着十几个赵家的精锐护卫，个个杀气腾腾，显然是得知了家中变故。
可当赵泰冲到前院，看清眼前的景象时，整个人瞬间僵住了。
他的宝贝女儿此刻竟然像狗一样，在地上爬。
“雪莲！”
“爹！”
看到赵泰，赵雪莲再也忍不住，眼泪汹涌而出。
然而，她刚想扑过去，却被楚枫手中的铁链束缚在了原地。
“爹，你可算回来了，你快救救我！

这个畜生毁了我的玄阴之体，还杀我哥，你一定要为我们报仇啊！”
赵泰猛地抬起头，眼神中的杀意几乎要凝成实质，周身的灵力疯狂涌动。
他咬牙切齿，一字一顿地吼道。
“楚枫，你这个忘恩负义的小杂种！
你竟然敢如此对待我的女儿，今日老夫定要将你碎尸万段，为我儿报仇！”
楚枫向前踏出一步，冷声道。
“你赵家鸠占鹊巢，霸占我楚家的灵池，用我楚家的资源培养女儿，还要给她找三皇子做下家。
如此所作所为，简直猪狗不如，还有脸说我忘恩负义？”
他的目光扫过在场的所有赵家人，朗声道。
“我楚枫今日，便当着所有人的面，休了赵雪莲这个贱人！
从今日起，赵雪莲再也不是我的妻子，她不配！”
“你敢！”
赵泰瞳孔一震，他怎么都没想到楚枫竟敢将他们赵家的脸扔到地上踩。
“你一个废物，竟然也敢当众休妻！”
赵雪莲听到楚枫当众休妻，气得浑身发抖。
“楚枫，我做鬼也不会放过你！”
就在赵泰怒不可遏之时，一位美妇轻轻拉住了她的胳膊。
柳玉茹的脸上带着一丝虚伪的笑容，低声道。
“夫君，别动气，这里还有不少楚家人呢，杀这个小杂种，何须你动手。”
闻听此言，赵泰顿时眼前一亮。

让楚家人去杀楚家人，才是真正的杀人诛心啊！
这样一来，不仅能除掉楚枫这个祸害，还能让楚家所有人都纳了投名状。
他转头看向那些站在人群中，神色复杂的楚家人，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
“楚家人都给我站出来！”
这些楚家人，都是当年楚枫父亲死后，投靠了赵家之人。
他们靠着赵家的庇护生存，早已成了赵家的狗。
“谁杀了楚枫，从今往后便是我赵家的供奉，享不尽的荣华富贵！
谁若是敢不动手，便是我赵家的敌人！”
话音落下，人群中那些楚家人面面相觑，眼神中皆是闪过一丝犹豫。
一个身材微胖的中年男人率先走了出来，他是楚枫的四叔楚山。
他腰间长剑出鞘，而后开口道。
“大侄子，你也听到了，你若是不死我们就得死，我们也是被逼无奈啊。”
紧接着，又一个年轻男子走了出来，他是楚枫的堂兄楚河。
他眼神闪烁，语气带着一丝愧疚。
“楚枫，你杀了大少爷，毁了大小姐，赵家是绝不会放过你的。
你若是自行了断，我们还能为你收尸，保全你最后的体面。”
楚枫嗤笑一声，眼神冰冷地看着他们。
“当年我父亲待你们不薄，如今我楚家遭难，你们不仅不思报答，反而投靠赵家，做他们的狗，你们也配跟我谈体面？”
楚山脸色一沉，语气变得凶狠起来。
“识时务者为俊杰，你何必执迷不悟，连累我们所有人？

你也不想因为你一个人，让我们这么多楚家人受牵连吧？”
“就是，楚枫，你就乖乖受死吧！”
楚河也跟着附和，拔出了腰间的长剑。
看着这些熟悉又陌生的面孔，楚枫只觉得一阵荒诞。
这些人都是他的族人，流淌着楚家的血脉，可如今变得如此丑陋不堪。
他缓缓抬起手，目光扫过在场的所有楚家人。
“三息之内，滚出赵家，否则便是我的敌人。”
“哈哈哈……楚枫，你还真是大言不惭！”
楚山像是听到了天大的笑话，捂着肚子大笑起来。
“你以为你恢复了修为就了不起了，别忘了你就是一个废物！”
其他的楚家人也纷纷附和，在他们看来，楚枫就算恢复了修为，也依旧是那个可以被他们随意欺负的废物。
“三息已到。”
楚枫的声音没有丝毫起伏，眼中的寒意却越来越浓。
“大侄子，让四叔送你一程吧！”
楚山运转体内的灵力，筑基五重的修为尽数爆发，手中的长剑率先刺出。
他的速度很快，剑势凌厉，显然是想一击致命。
周围的楚家人脸上都露出了得意的笑容，楚山是他们之中修为最高的人，这一剑下去，楚枫必死无疑。
然而，就在长剑即将刺中他胸口的瞬间，楚枫的身形骤然一动，原地只留下一道淡淡的残影。
“什么？”
楚山瞳孔骤缩，脸上的得意瞬间凝固。

他根本没看清楚枫的动作，只觉得眼前一花，对方就消失在了原地。
下一秒，楚枫的身影出现在了楚山的面前，右手成拳，带着磅礴的天地之力，狠狠轰向楚山的胸口。
楚山刚要挥剑格挡，却觉得胸口一凉，一股剧痛瞬间席卷全身。
他缓缓低下头，难以置信地看着自己的胸口。
只见楚枫的手掌，竟然径直穿过了他的胸膛，紧紧攥住了那颗还在疯狂跳动的心脏。
“不……不可能！”楚山的声音带着一丝哀求，“别，我可是你四叔啊！”
“你不过是赵家的狗。”
话音落下，楚枫的五指猛地收紧。
那颗鲜活的心脏被楚枫彻底捏碎，楚山的身体骤然绷紧，眼睛瞪得滚圆，口中喷出一大口鲜血。
他脸上还残留着难以置信的神色，身子却缓缓倒了下去，彻底没了气息。
这一幕，瞬间让在场的所有人都惊呆了。
楚家众人看着楚山的尸体，浑身控制不住地颤抖起来。
“筑基五重的楚山，竟然被一招秒杀了？”
“这怎么可能，楚枫的修为到底达到了什么境界？”
“他不是废物吗，怎么会这么强？”
楚山是他们之中修为最高的人，连他都被楚枫一招秒杀，他们这些人，又怎么可能是楚枫的对手？
刚才还气势汹汹的楚家人，此刻瞬间没了底气，纷纷后退。
“楚……大侄子，我们也是被逼无奈啊！”
“我们都是楚家人，血浓于水啊！”
“我们根本不想杀你，放我们一条生路。”

虽然嘴上这么说，但是众人手中的长剑谁都没有放下。
楚枫手中长剑斩出，一道道赤色的剑气骤然乍现，交织成一张巨大的剑网，朝着楚家人笼罩而去。
星罗剑网！
噗！噗！噗！
那些楚家人还没来得及逃，便被剑气斩断了头颅，身首异处。
楚枫站在血泊之中，眼神冰冷得没有一丝波澜。
“我给过你们机会，是你们自己不珍惜。”
content_en:
Chu Feng held a dark iron chain in his left hand, and the other end of the chain was tied around Zhao Xuelian's neck.
With every step he took, the chain made a harsh clanking sound.
Zhao Xuelian struggled to crawl on the ground with her hands, her luxurious clothes already worn to tatters.
Her messy hair covered most of her face, leaving only a pair of vicious eyes staring at the ground.
Chu Feng, just wait for me. When my father comes back, I will ride on you and climb all over Qingshan City.
Let everyone know that you are my dog!
This scene quickly alarmed everyone in the Zhao family.
The Zhao family members were crowded around, their faces filled with overwhelming anger, and they were all yelling curses at Chu Feng.
"You fucking beast, you fucking beast!"
"How dare you treat the eldest lady like this? You are worse than a pig or a dog!"
"The eldest lady spared his life, and now he's repaying her kindness with revenge!"
These curses came one after another, rushing towards Chu Feng like a tide.
Chu Feng's eyes swept over those who clamored the loudest, and the corner of his mouth curled up with a sarcastic arc.
These people pointed at him, but no one dared to really step forward.
"Noisy."
Before he finished speaking, Chu Feng flicked his fingers, and several strands of spiritual power that were as condensed as a bolt of steel suddenly shot out, so fast that no one could react at all.
puff! puff! puff!
A series of dull sounds sounded, and the heads of those who had scolded the most fiercely just now were instantly pierced by spiritual power, and blood mixed with brain matter spurted out.
Their corpses fell straight to the ground, their eyes widened, still retaining the shock of their death.
The courtyard, which had been extremely noisy just now, instantly fell into deathly silence.
Everyone was frightened by this sudden bloody scene. Everyone who was filled with indignation just now retreated one after another, fearing that they would be the next to suffer.
Zhao Xuelian was also frightened by this scene, and her crawling movements paused.
She raised her head suddenly, and under her messy hair, a pair of eyes stared at Chu Feng.
"Where exactly are you taking me?"
Chu Feng looked at her condescendingly. The sunlight shone on his face, but it couldn't illuminate the chill in his eyes.
"Your father is back. As a daughter, of course you have to go out and greet him properly."
"My father is back?" Zhao Xuelian's pupils shrank suddenly, and then she felt happy, "My father will definitely avenge me. He will make you die through the most painful torture in the world!"
Chu Feng sneered and kicked her hard.
"I'm waiting for him to come!"
Not long after, a thunderous roar came from the distance, breaking the silence of the courtyard.
"Chu Feng, you little bastard, get out of here and die!"
Everyone followed the sound and saw a middle-aged man rushing to the front yard menacingly. The man who came was none other than Zhao Tai, the head of the Zhao family.
Behind him were more than a dozen elite guards of the Zhao family, all of them murderous, obviously having learned of the changes in their family.
But when Zhao Tai rushed to the front yard and saw the scene in front of him clearly, his whole body froze instantly.
His precious daughter was crawling on the ground like a dog at this moment.
"Snow lotus!"
"Dad!"
Seeing Zhao Tai, Zhao Xuelian could no longer hold back and burst into tears.
However, just as she was about to pounce, she was restrained in place by the iron chain in Chu Feng's hand.
"Dad, you are finally back, please help me!
This beast destroyed my Xuanyin body and killed my brother. You must avenge us! "
Zhao Tai raised his head suddenly, the murderous intent in his eyes almost solidified, and the spiritual energy around him surged crazily.
He gritted his teeth and roared word by word.
"Chu Feng, you ungrateful little bastard!
How dare you treat my daughter like this? Today I will cut you into pieces to avenge my son! "
Chu Feng took a step forward and said coldly.
"You, the Zhao family, occupy the magpie's nest, occupy my Chu family's spiritual pond, use my Chu family's resources to train your daughter, and even find the third prince to be her next wife.
Doing this,I'm worse than a pig or a dog. How dare you call me ungrateful? "
He glanced at all the Zhao family members present and said loudly.
"Today, I, Chu Feng, divorced this bitch Zhao Xuelian in front of everyone!
From today on, Zhao Xuelian is no longer my wife, she is not worthy! "
"You dare! "
Zhao Tai's pupils were shocked. He never expected that Chu Feng would dare to throw the Zhao family's face to the ground and stomp on it.
“You’re such a loser, how dare you divorce your wife in public! "
When Zhao Xuelian heard that Chu Feng had divorced his wife in public, she was so angry that she trembled all over.
"Chu Feng, I won't let you go even if I'm a ghost! "
Just when Zhao Tai was furious, a beautiful woman gently pulled her arm.
Liu Yuru said in a low voice with a false smile on her face.
"Husband, don't be angry. There are many Chu family members here. Why do you need to kill this little bastard? "
After hearing this, Zhao Tai's eyes suddenly lit up.
Letting the Chu family kill the Chu family is the real murderous act!
In this way, not only can the scourge Chu Feng be eliminated, but also everyone in the Chu family can submit a petition.
He turned to look at the Chu family members who were standing in the crowd with complicated expressions, and a sneer curled up at the corner of his mouth.
"Everyone in the Chu family will stand up for me! "
These Chu family members are all people who took refuge with the Zhao family after Chu Feng's father died.
They rely on the protection of the Zhao family to survive and have long become the dogs of the Zhao family.
"Whoever kills Chu Feng will be worshiped by my Zhao family from now on and enjoy endless glory and wealth!
Anyone who dares not to take action is the enemy of my Zhao family! "
After the words fell, the Chu family members in the crowd looked at each other with a trace of hesitation in their eyes.
A slightly fat middle-aged man walked out first. He was Chu Feng's fourth uncle Chu Shan.
He unsheathed the sword at his waist and then spoke.
"Eldest nephew, you heard it too. If you don't die, we will die. We are forced to have no choice. "
Immediately afterwards, another young man came out. He was Chu Feng's cousin Chu He.
His eyes flickered and his tone was filled with guilt.
"Chu Feng, if you kill the eldest young master and destroy the eldest lady, the Zhao family will never let you go.
If you commit suicide on your own, we can collect your body and preserve your last dignity. "
Chu Feng sneered and looked at them with cold eyes.
"My father treated you well back then, but now that our Chu family is suffering, not only do you not want to repay you, but you have taken refuge in the Zhao family and become their dogs, are you worthy of talking to me about dignity? "
Chu Shan's face darkened and his tone became fierce.
"He who understands the current affairs is a hero, why do you insist on stubbornness and bring trouble to all of us?
You don’t want so many of our Chu family members to be implicated just because of you, right? "
"That's right, Chu Feng, just accept your death! "
Chu He also followed suit and pulled out the long sword from his waist.
Looking at these familiar and unfamiliar faces, Chu Feng felt a sense of absurdity.
These people are all his clansmen, with the blood of the Chu family flowing through them, but now they have become so ugly.
He slowly raised his hand and glanced at all the Chu family members present.
"Get out of the Zhao family within three breaths, otherwise you will be my enemy. "
"Hahaha...Chu Feng, you are really arrogant! "
Chu Shan seemed to have heard a big joke, holding his stomach and laughing.
"You think it's great that you have recovered your cultivation, but don't forget that you are a waste! "
The other Chu family members also agreed. In their opinion, even if Chu Feng recovered his cultivation, he would still be a loser who could be bullied by them at will.
“Three breaths have arrived. "
Chu Feng's voice did not fluctuate at all, but the chill in his eyes became stronger and stronger.
"Eldest nephew, let your fourth uncle give you a ride! "
Chu Shan circulated the spiritual power in his body, and his fifth-level foundation-building cultivation exploded, and he thrust out the long sword in his hand first.
His speed was very fast and his sword was powerful, obviously he wanted to kill him with one blow.
The Chu family members around them all had proud smiles on their faces.Chu Shan is the person with the highest cultivation level among them. If this sword strikes, Chu Feng will definitely die.
However, just when the long sword was about to pierce his chest, Chu Feng's figure suddenly moved, leaving only a faint afterimage on the spot.
"What?"
Chushan's pupils shrank suddenly, and the pride on his face instantly froze.
He didn't see Feng's movements clearly at all. He only felt that the other party disappeared in front of his eyes.
The next second, Chu Feng's figure appeared in front of Chu Shan. His right hand formed a fist, and with the majestic power of heaven and earth, it struck Chu Shan's chest fiercely.
Just as Chu Shan was about to block with his sword, he felt a chill in his chest and a sharp pain instantly swept through his body.
He slowly lowered his head and looked at his chest in disbelief.
Chu Feng's palm actually went straight through his chest, tightly grasping the heart that was still beating wildly.
"No...impossible!" Chu Shan's voice was filled with pleading, "No, I'm your fourth uncle!"
"You are just the Zhao family's dog."
After the words fell, Chu Feng's fingers tightened suddenly.
The living heart was completely crushed by Chu Feng. Chu Shan's body suddenly tensed up, his eyes widened, and a large mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth.
There was still a look of disbelief on his face, but his body slowly fell down, completely lifeless.
This scene instantly stunned everyone present.
Everyone in the Chu family looked at Chu Shan's body and trembled uncontrollably.
"Chu Shan, who was at the fifth level of Foundation Establishment, was killed instantly with one move?"
"How is this possible? What level of cultivation has Chu Feng reached?"
"Isn't he useless? How can he be so strong?"
Chu Shan is the person with the highest cultivation level among them, and even he was instantly killed by Chu Feng with one move. How could they be Chu Feng's opponents?
The Chu family, who had been so aggressive just now, instantly lost their confidence and retreated one after another.
"Chu... eldest nephew, we are also forced to have no choice!"
"We are all Chu family, blood is thicker than water!"
"We don't want to kill you at all, let us live."
Although they said this, no one put down the sword in their hands.
Chu Feng slashed out the long sword in his hand, and streaks of red sword energy suddenly appeared, intertwined into a huge sword net, and enveloped the Chu family.
Xingluo Sword Network!
puff! puff! puff!
Before those Chu family members could escape, their heads were cut off by the sword energy, and their heads were missing.
Chu Feng stood in a pool of blood, his eyes so cold that there was no trace of emotion.
"I gave you a chance, but you didn't cherish it."
